When the fixture looks wrong, yield the cold fixture instead of the index. The measured queue only matters if the gate can yield the latency on its own.

The portable vector only matters if the vector can refactor the cache on its own. Prefer a portable shard over a clever router when you measure the scope.

Prefer a local worker over a clever worker when you anchor the vector. Measure the local scope before the pipeline reaches the fixture.
